propositions: A new plan-review criterion T15 'overlay-derisk' must be authored with YAML front-matter (title, category, execution_mode: agentic, dimension: overlay-derisk) and a rubric body containing S1-S3 applicability gates and checks (a)-(d) with ANTI-FP guidance, to be written verbatim into src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T15.md.

The routing entry for T15 in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json must specify exec='AGENT', facet='overlay-derisk', overlay_routing='llm', and applies_at suppress_types=['bug'], distinct from the front-matter execution_mode enum value 'agentic'.
T15 must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py and the guide must be regenerated via the registry regenerate-criteria-guide command.
The rebar explain T15 command must render the criterion name from the front-matter title, exec tier AGENT, facet overlay-derisk, and the complete rubric body (S1-S3 gates and checks a-d).

Registry validators must pass without missing entries, routing validation must succeed, and the regenerated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md must contain a complete T15 section with all four checks named.
